shortBulletSummary: Crypto Fear & Greed Index at 12 (Extreme Fear). This reflects extremely bearish investor sentiment.
Bitcoin fell to $59K; over $1B crypto liquidated in 24 hrs. Bitcoin's price dropped significantly, triggering massive liquidations.
US PCE inflation hit 4.1%; Fed policy signals tighter liquidity. Higher inflation could lead to a more hawkish Fed, impacting risk assets.
Geopolitical tensions involving Iran contributing to market caution. Geopolitical instability adds uncertainty to global and crypto markets.
Bitcoin ETFs see outflows, extending into a seventh week. Continued outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs indicate reduced institutional demand.
